confirmation_day: next market session; close>=reversal high and close location>=70%
cooldown: first confirmation per symbol in each causal 10-session window
economic_hypothesis: Inside a causal broad BULL state and healthy industry, a former strong stock's lower-low positive reversal is only provisional absorption. The next completed session must close above the reversal high and in its own upper 30% before supply transfer is treated as confirmed.
entry: first legal next daily open after completed confirmation
exit: target or causal H5/H10/H15 decision then next legal open
industry: confirmation-day median ret20>0 and positive-ret20 share>50%

market.BEAR: both medians <= 0 AND both positive-return shares <= 0.50
market.BULL: market median ret20 > 0 AND positive-ret20 share > 0.50 AND market median ret60 > 0 AND positive-ret60 share > 0.50
market.TRANSITION: all other combinations or missing required state
market.strategy_action: trade only BULL; BEAR and TRANSITION hold cash

reversal_day.liquidation: new five-session low >=10% or 15% below prior20 high
